achievements.name: Opening Assault
achievements.detail: Clear the prologue battle against the Homunculi in the city.

achievements.name: Witch Time
achievements.detail: Dodge an attack at the last instant so Witch Time slows the fight.

achievements.name: Demon Slave
achievements.detail: Summon an Infernal Demon and control it yourself during a fight.

achievements.name: Demon Masquerade
achievements.detail: Activate Demon Masquerade and fight in the form tied to your equipped weapon.

achievements.name: Viola's Verse
achievements.detail: Clear a verse as Viola with her katana and the demon Cheshire.

achievements.name: Jeanne's Side
achievements.detail: Finish one of the side chapters played as Jeanne.

achievements.name: Tear of Blood
achievements.detail: Catch a crow, cat, or toad and take the Umbran Tear of Blood it carries.

achievements.name: Phenomenal Remnant
achievements.detail: Collect a chapter's three Tears of Blood and clear the Phenomenal Remnant they open.

achievements.name: Pure Platinum
achievements.detail: Earn a Pure Platinum medal for a story chapter.

achievements.name: New Weapon
achievements.detail: Equip a weapon other than the starting guns and clear a verse with it.

achievements.name: Gates of Hell
achievements.detail: Spend seeds at the Gates of Hell on a technique, item, or weapon from Rodin.

achievements.name: Final Chapter
achievements.detail: Clear the last chapter of the story.
